“Subhūti, the complete realization of the signless is as follows: if a bodhisattva mahāsattva does not mentally engage with any signs, this is the bodhisattva mahāsattva’s complete realization of the signless.
Bhagavān, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva completely fulfill the knowledge of the wishless?
Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva, regarding the phenomena of the three realms, [does not direct] the mind...”
Non-abiding. This is how a bodhisattva mahāsattva should fulfill the knowledge of wishlessness (*apraṇihita*).
"Blessed One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the purity of the three spheres (*trimaṇḍalapariśuddhi*)?

"Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva is fully endowed with the ten paths of wholesome action (*daśakuśalakarmapatha*), this is how a bodhisattva mahāsattva should fulfill the purity of the three spheres."
“Pure, World-Honored One! How should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill compassion for sentient beings and non-attachment toward sentient beings?

“Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva has already attained great compassion and purified the buddha-field, this is how a bodhisattva mahāsattva should fulfill compassion for sentient beings and non-attachment toward sentient beings.”
"Without attachment. World-Honored One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the equal vision of all phenomena, and remain without attachment therein?
Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva neither increases nor decreases any phenomenon, and therein neither grasps nor dwells, this is the bodhisattva mahāsattva..."
A bodhisattva should fulfill the vision of the equality of all phenomena, and therein remain without attachment.
"Blessed One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the vision of the equality of all sentient beings, and therein remain without attachment?
"Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva neither increases nor [diminishes] with respect to all sentient beings..."

"Diminishing, and therein neither grasping nor dwelling— this is what constitutes a bodhisattva mahāsattva’s fulfillment of the equal vision toward all sentient beings, as well as being without attachment therein. Blessed One,
how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the thorough penetration of the principle of reality, and be without attachment therein?"
"Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva, although having realized the true principle of all phenomena as they truly are,
has no realization and neither grasps nor dwells therein—
this is what it means for a bodhisattva mahāsattva to fulfill the realization of the true principle and to have no attachment therein. World-Honored One."
How should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the wisdom of the patience regarding non-arising?

Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva endures that all phenomena are without arising and without cessation, are without volitional construction, and understands that name-and-form are ultimately non-arisen—this is how a bodhisattva mahāsattva should fulfill the wisdom of the patience regarding non-arising. World-Honored One, how is this so?
A bodhisattva mahāsattva should fulfill the principle of the single characteristic of all phenomena.

Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva practices with regard to all phenomena by way of non-dual characteristics, this is the fulfillment of the bodhisattva mahāsattva’s principle of the single characteristic of all phenomena. World-Honored One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva...

“Subhūti, the complete elimination of conceptualization is as follows: if a bodhisattva mahāsattva does not give rise to conceptualization regarding any phenomena, this is the bodhisattva mahāsattva’s fulfillment of the complete elimination of conceptualization.
“Blessed One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the distancing from all perceptions? “Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva...”
To remain far removed from all notions of the small, the great, and the immeasurable—this is how a bodhisattva mahāsattva should fulfill the complete removal of all notions.
World-Honored One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the complete removal of all views?
Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva remains far removed from all views of the śrāvakas, pratyekabuddhas, and so forth—this is [how they should fulfill it].
“A bodhisattva mahāsattva should fulfill the complete distancing from all views. Bhagavān, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the complete distancing from afflictions?

Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva abandons the continuity of all outflows, afflictions, and habitual tendencies, this is what it means for a bodhisattva mahāsattva to fulfill the complete distancing from afflictions.”
“Vexed, World-Honored One! How should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the stage of śamatha and vipaśyanā?

“Subhūti, it is when a bodhisattva mahāsattva cultivates the path of all-knowledge (sarvajñatā), the knowledge of the aspects of the path (mārgajñatā), and the knowledge of all aspects (sarvākārajñatā).”
This is the stage of śamatha and vipaśyanā that a bodhisattva mahāsattva should fulfill.
"World-Honored One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the taming of the mind?
"Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva finds no delight in and remains unmoved by the phenomena of the three realms, this is how a bodhisattva mahāsattva should fulfill [the taming of the mind]."
“Blessed One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the tranquility of the mental continuum?
Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva skillfully restrains the six sense faculties, this is how a bodhisattva mahāsattva should fulfill the tranquility of the mental continuum.
Blessed One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill non-obstruction?”
“Wisdom-nature. Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva cultivates and attains the Buddha-eye, this is the bodhisattva mahāsattva’s fulfillment of the wisdom-nature that is unimpeded.
Bhagavān, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill non-attachment? Subhūti, it is when a bodhisattva mahāsattva is able to skillfully relinquish the six external sense bases.”
This is how a bodhisattva mahāsattva should fulfill being free from attachment.
"World-Honored One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill going to all buddha-fields according to their heart's desire and manifesting their own body within the assemblies of those Buddhas?
"Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva cultivates supreme supernormal powers, they proceed from one buddha-field to another..."
In the Buddha-fields, they honor, revere, respect, and praise the Buddhas, the World-Honored Ones; they entreat them to turn the wheel of Dharma for the benefit of all beings.
This is the bodhisattva-mahāsattva’s fulfillment of going to all Buddha-fields according to their heart's desire.
He manifests his own body within the assemblies of the Buddhas. "World-Honored One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the penetration into the mental activities of all sentient beings?
"Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva, by means of a single mind of wisdom..."
To know, as they truly are, the minds and mental factors of all sentient beings—this is the bodhisattva mahāsattva’s fulfillment of the entry into the mental conduct of all sentient beings.
"Bhagavān, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the mastery of the various supernormal powers? "Subhūti, it is when a bodhisattva mahāsattva masters various [powers] for themselves..."

Regarding the supernormal powers (*abhijñā*): for the sake of seeing the Buddhas, he travels from one Buddha-field to another, yet he does not give rise to the thought that he is traveling through Buddha-fields.
This, World-Honored One, is the bodhisattva mahāsattva’s fulfillment of the mastery of the supernormal powers.
How should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the vision of all buddha-fields and, according to what he sees, personally adorn and purify various buddha-fields?
Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva, while dwelling in a single buddha-field,
is able to see the infinite buddha-lands of the ten directions and can also manifest them, yet never gives rise to the notion of "buddha-land," and furthermore—

For the sake of maturing all sentient beings, they manifest in the position of a wheel-turning monarch (*cakravartin*) within the trichiliocosm to adorn themselves, yet they are also able to relinquish it without any attachment.
This is how a bodhisattva mahāsattva should fulfill the vision of all buddha-fields and, according to what they have seen, personally purify various buddha-fields. World-Honored One, how is this so?
A bodhisattva mahāsattva should fulfill the service and veneration of the Buddhas, the World-Honored Ones, by observing the body of the Tathāgata as it truly is.
Subhūti, this is because a bodhisattva mahāsattva desires to bring benefit and aid to all sentient beings.
To discern the meaning and intent of the Dharma as it truly is—this is called honoring and serving the Buddhas through the offering of the Dharma.

Furthermore, to contemplate the Dharmakāya of all Buddhas with precise observation is what constitutes the fulfillment of the bodhisattva mahāsattva’s honoring and service of the Buddhas, the World-Honored Ones, by contemplating the body of the Tathāgata as it truly is. World-Honored One, how does a bodhisattva...
A mahāsattva should fulfill the knowledge that discerns the superior and inferior faculties of all sentient beings.

Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva, abiding in the ten powers of a Buddha, knows as they truly are the superior and inferior faculties of all sentient beings, this is called the bodhisattva mahāsattva’s fulfillment of the knowledge that discerns the superior and inferior faculties of all sentient beings. World-Honored One, how is this so?
A bodhisattva mahāsattva should fulfill the purification of the buddha-field.

Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva, by means of non-apprehension as a skillful method, purifies the mental activities of all sentient beings, this is what is meant by a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfilling the purification of the buddha-field. World-Honored One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva...
Subhūti, a bodhisattva mahāsattva who repeatedly enters various meditative absorptions that are perfected as being like an illusion—

though they accomplish all activities while remaining unmoved in mind— and because their cultivation of these meditative absorptions is so thoroughly matured that they manifest them again and again without further effort:
this is what it means for a bodhisattva mahāsattva to be fully perfected.
Entering various meditative absorptions repeatedly through the "illusion-like" samādhi, [Subhūti] asked:

"Blessed One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the practice of entering various states of existence in order to bring the roots of virtue of sentient beings to maturity? How does he manifest birth by transformation for himself? The Blessed One replied:
"Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva, desiring to mature the sublime roots of virtue of the various classes of sentient beings, acts according to what is appropriate for them..."

Therefore, they enter into the various realms of existence and manifest birth therein. This is how a bodhisattva mahāsattva enters into the various realms of existence by manifesting spontaneous birth (upapāduka) in accordance with the ripening of the roots of virtue of sentient beings.
World-Honored One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the great vow of encompassing infinite locations, so that whatever they vow shall all be brought to fulfillment? Well done!

Manifestation. If a bodhisattva mahāsattva has already fully cultivated the six pāramitās to the point of ultimate perfection, then—whether for the purpose of adorning and purifying the buddha-fields or for the purpose of maturing sentient beings—all their aspirations will be fulfilled according to their wishes.
This is called the bodhisattva mahāsattva’s perfection of embracing infinite locations.
May all aspirations be fulfilled according to their wishes.

World-Honored One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the knowledge of the diverse languages of gods, nāgas, yakṣas, gandharvas, asuras, garuḍas, kiṃnaras, mahoragas, humans, and non-humans? Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva practices...
They cultivate the unimpeded analytical knowledge of language, skillfully knowing the distinctions among the vocal expressions of sentient beings.
This is how a bodhisattva mahāsattva should fulfill [the knowledge] corresponding to that of devas, nāgas, yakṣas, gandharvas, asuras, and garuḍas.
Regarding the knowledge of the diverse sounds of *kiṃnara*s, *mahoraga*s, humans, non-humans, and other such classes of beings:
World-Honored One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the knowledge of unimpeded eloquence? Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva...
By cultivating the supreme analytical knowledge of eloquence (*pratibhāna-pratisaṃvid*), one is able to teach inexhaustibly for the sake of all sentient beings.
This is the bodhisattva mahāsattva’s fulfillment of the wisdom of unimpeded eloquent discourse.
"Blessed One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the perfection of entering the womb? "Subhūti, although a bodhisattva mahāsattva [enters] all places of birth..."
In reality, they are always born by transformation; yet, for the benefit of sentient beings, they manifest entry into a womb, wherein they are endowed with all manner of sublime qualities.
This is the bodhisattva mahāsattva’s fulfillment of the perfection of entering the womb.
World-Honored One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the perfection of birth? Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva—
At the time of emerging from the womb, he manifests various rare and sublime events, causing all sentient beings who see them to rejoice and obtain great benefit and happiness.
This, World-Honored One, is the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva’s perfection of birth that should be fulfilled.
How should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the perfection of a noble lineage?
Subhūti, it is when a bodhisattva mahāsattva is born either into a great kṣatriya clan or into a great brāhmaṇa clan.
The parents from whom one receives birth are beyond reproach; this is what constitutes the bodhisattva mahāsattva’s fulfillment of the perfection of family lineage.
World-Honored One, how does a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the perfection of noble lineage? Subhūti, [it is as follows:]...
If a bodhisattva mahāsattva is always born into the lineage of the great bodhisattvas of the past, this is called the bodhisattva mahāsattva’s fulfillment of the perfection of lineage.
"Bhagavān, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the perfection of retinue? "Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva consists entirely of immeasurable..."
They have incalculable bodhisattvas as their retinue, not various other classes of beings.
This is what is meant by a bodhisattva mahāsattva’s fulfillment of the perfection of a retinue. World-Honored One, how should a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the perfection of the physical body?
Subhūti, it is when, at the time of his first birth, the bodhisattva mahāsattva’s body is complete in all respects.
He possesses the primary and secondary marks and emits great radiance that illuminates the boundless worlds of all Buddhas, causing those realms to tremble in six ways;
any sentient beings who encounter this do not fail to receive benefit. This is called the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva’s fulfillment of the perfection of the birth-body (*janmakāya*).
World-Honored One, how does a Bodhisattva Mahāsattva fulfill the perfection of renunciation?
Subhūti, when a bodhisattva mahāsattva goes forth from home, he is followed by immeasurable and innumerable devas, nāgas, yakṣas, humans, non-humans,
and so forth as they proceed to the site of enlightenment, where he shaves off his hair and beard, dons the three dharma robes, and [goes forth].
He accepts and maintains the alms-bowl, guiding immeasurable and incalculable sentient beings, causing them to ride upon the three vehicles and proceed toward parinirvāṇa.
This is the bodhisattva mahāsattva’s perfection of the full endowment of renunciation.
World-Honored One, how does a bodhisattva mahāsattva fulfill the perfection of the adornment of the bodhi-tree? Subhūti, if a bodhisattva mahāsattva...
Through his sublime and excellent roots of goodness and the power of his vast vows, he brought forth such a wondrous Bodhi tree:
its trunk was made of Vaiḍūrya gemstone, its roots of pure gold, and its branches, leaves, flowers, and fruits were all composed of the most exquisite seven treasures.
This tree was so high and broad that it completely covered the trichiliocosm of Buddha-fields, its radiance shining throughout the ten directions.
Extending throughout as many Buddha-worlds as there are grains of sand in the Ganges River—this is the perfection of the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva’s complete adornment of the Bodhi tree.
World-Honored One, how should a Bodhisattva Mahāsattva fulfill the perfection of all meritorious qualities?
Subhūti, it is when a Bodhisattva Mahāsattva fulfills the sublime provisions of merit and wisdom.
Maturing sentient beings and purifying Buddha-fields: this is what constitutes the Bodhisattva Mahāsattva’s fulfillment of all qualities (fascicle fifty-four).
"Bhagavān, how should one know that a bodhisattva mahāsattva who has already perfected the tenth stage, the Cloud of Dharma (dharmameghā), is to be spoken of as no different from the Tathāgatas?
Subhūti, it is because such a bodhisattva has already perfected all the buddha-dharmas."
If, moreover, one permanently severs the continuity of all afflictions along with their habitual tendencies (*vāsanā*), one then abides in the stage of a Buddha.
Therefore, you should know that a Bodhisattva Mahāsattva who has already perfected the tenth stage, the Cloud of Dharma (*dharmameghā bhūmi*), should be said to be no different from the Tathāgatas.
Subhūti, you should know that this is what constitutes a Bodhisattva Mahāsattva setting out upon the Great Vehicle (*mahāyāna*).
The above concludes the response concerning the setting forth in the Great Vehicle. Below, the response concerns from where such a Great Vehicle emerges and where it abides.
Subhūti, such a Great Vehicle emerges from within the three realms and abides within the knowledge of all modes (sarvajñajñāna). This is because...
It is because one emerges from the triple world by means of the knowledge of all modes; yet, because there is no duality, there is neither emergence nor arrival.
Why is this? Whether it be the Great Vehicle or the knowledge of all modes, these two dharmas are neither associated nor dissociated.
It is neither with form nor without form; neither visible nor invisible; neither resistant nor non-resistant.
It is entirely of one single mark, namely, the markless. Regarding the markless Dharma, there is no departing and no arriving.
Whoever wishes to cause the markless Dharma to have departing and arriving, thereby wishes to cause all dharmas to have departing and arriving. For this reason...
Why is this? Because all phenomena cannot emerge from within the three realms, nor can they abide within the knowledge of all-knowledge.
Why is this? Because the intrinsic nature of all phenomena is empty; as phenomena without marks, they are devoid of movement or transition.
Next, to answer the question of where this Great Vehicle abides: Subhūti, this Great Vehicle abides nowhere at all.
Why is that? Because all phenomena abide nowhere. For what reason? Because an abiding place for any phenomenon cannot be apprehended.
Nevertheless, this Great Vehicle abides in non-abiding.
Next, to answer the question of who it is that "rides upon this Great Vehicle and departs": Subhūti, there is absolutely no one who rides upon this Great Vehicle and departs.

Why is this? Because whether it be the vehicle being ridden or the rider, the place from which one departs, the destination to which one goes, and the very moment of departing and arriving—all such things are non-existent and entirely unattainable. Why?
Therefore, because all dharmas are non-existent and entirely unobtainable, being ultimately pure;
all dharmas have not been obtainable in the past, will not be obtainable in the future, and are not obtainable in the present, being ultimately pure.
(The "Chapter on Discerning the Mahāyāna" concludes.)
